page.overview:
Who is Barry?

Appearing in the Mirage continuity issue Men of Shadow, Barry is a teenage bully who lives in Arkham, Massachusetts. Frequent targets of his abuse are Maximillian Jones and Pervis Walker, but especially the former.

Toward the beginning of Men of Shadow, Barry and a couple of his cronies show up just as Max and Pervis exit the comic store Altered Earth Arts. He grabs Pervis by the shirt, but when Max tries to intervene, he redirects his attention to him. One of Barry's subordinates alerts him that the police are nearby, prompting Barry to just grab Max's newly purchased copy of The Dark Knight Returns and rip it in half, before tossing it back to him and leaving.

Max and Pervis went on an adventure with the , , , and Clark Ashton Allard and were integral in saving the world from Dagon. Afterwards they encountered Barry and his crew again. Max thought that after the ordeal they'd been through, he could take Barry on without a problem, but was given a black eye for his troubles.
